words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the ayah as confirmed declaration rather than neutral continuation. It governs {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) and frames the superior-knowledge predicate, so the unsettled diagnostic pressure from 68:6 yields to settled divine knowledge without naming a human party. The doubled sound gives that confirmation audible pressure.

topics.headline: confirmed divine-knowledge declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah leaves question-pressure behind by opening a settled divine-knowledge declaration.
topics.reason: The word is an emphatic annulative particle governing the first nominal clause, and the boundary rows tie its confirmation to the prior question-pressure.

topics.headline: doubled opening pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the confirmation as a pressed opening, not only as an abstract syntactic marker.
topics.reason: The visible and recited doubled consonant supports a surface-form payoff without changing the particle role.

words.prose: {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) makes the knower the addressee's own Lord, not a detached authority. The suffix fixes a singular addressee while the later objects remain third-person categories. The root field of ownership, nurture, and governance makes the superior knowledge feel like rightful lordly adjudication, and the recurring {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) pattern places this instance inside a familiar divine-knowledge formula. The geminated center of the title gives that addressed Lordship compact weight after the emphatic opener.

topics.headline: possessed Lord-title addresses the addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the classification is spoken through the Lord-title bound to the addressed person.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically forced and refers to the single direct addressee.

topics.headline: lordship field colors epistemic authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that superior knowledge is carried by a Lord-title whose root field includes governance and nurture.
topics.reason: The local noun remains a title, while the root family validly colors it with authority, nurture, and management.

topics.headline: subject title under confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the layered grammar: the word is governed by confirmation while semantically carrying the predicate subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the accusative subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), with {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) as predicate.

topics.headline: formulaic Lord-knowledge frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord-title belongs to a recurring formula for divine epistemic supremacy and governs the path-domain named later.
topics.reason: The rows name recurring parallels at 6:117, 16:125, and 53:30, and the suffix on {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}) later resumes this Lord-title.

topics.headline: geminated title weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Lord-title as a compact stressed center after the emphatic opener.
topics.reason: The geminated consonant is a surface feature that supports a modest sound payoff.

words.prose: The first {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) is not a new participant. It stands between {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) and {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) as a separating pronoun, making the predicate read as a clean assertion rather than a loose adjective. That placement concentrates the claim on this subject and excludes rival human classifications, while the repeated surface later shifts into an ordinary subject role.

topics.headline: pronoun separates subject and predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun prevents the elative from reading as a mere descriptive adjective.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun as resuming {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) before the predicate.

topics.headline: exclusive subject focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge claim is restricted to the divine subject over against rival judgments.
topics.reason: As a pronoun of separation, the word supports focus on the very subject before the elative predicate.

topics.headline: same surface shifts function later
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same pronoun shape marks both predicate thresholds while changing function across the ayah.
topics.reason: The first occurrence separates subject and predicate; word 10 is the subject of the coordinated clause.

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) completes the confirmed nominal clause. As an elative, it does more than say that God knows; it ranks divine knowledge above competing human classification. Its {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}})-object construction directs that superior knowledge toward the person-category introduced by {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}). The knowledge family also brings making-known and known-domain pressure, while the local form remains the elative predicate of superior knowledge. The second occurrence repeats this predicate, so the first one sets the recognizable adjudication template by which both deviation and guidance are judged.

topics.headline: superior knowledge predicate governs ba-object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first knowledge claim is a stable elative predicate with its object marked through {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}).
topics.reason: The word is the predicate of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), an elative adjective, and governs {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) as complement.

topics.headline: teaching and domain pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices family pressure of making-known and known-domain range, while the local form remains superior knowledge.
topics.reason: Derivative family evidence can color the knowledge field, but local grammar selects the elative predicate sense.

topics.headline: known formula for judging deviation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is a recognizable divine-knowledge formula for adjudicating who has gone astray.
topics.reason: The rows provide recurring formula surfaces and co-occurrence with {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}) and {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}).

topics.headline: first predicate sets the paired frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first predicate is built to be repeated, making one epistemic frame span both opposed categories.
topics.reason: The second {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) is coordinated with the first and repeats the same predicate form.

words.prose: {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) compresses the object marker and the open human category into one surface word. The {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the category the object of {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}), while the pronoun inside {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) keeps it unnamed and open: the one who strayed, or whoever strays. That openness contrasts with the definite plural at the end, so deviation unfolds as a relative clause while guidance arrives as a known group.

topics.headline: fused object marker and human category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first object of knowledge begins as a governed person-category, not as a named antagonist.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the pronoun in {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) as governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) after {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}).

topics.headline: open relative or conditional class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the strayer category remains open enough to cover whoever fits the clause.
topics.reason: The word functions locally as a headless relative while the conditional generalizing pressure remains compatible as scope nuance.

topics.headline: relative clause versus definite plural
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the asymmetry: straying is introduced by an unfolding clause, while the guided are later named as a definite plural.
topics.reason: The first object spans {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}) {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}) {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}), while the second object is a definite plural noun.

words.prose: {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}) names the negative pole as an established act of deviation by the open {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) subject. The verb is not left abstract: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}) {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}) makes it departure from a defined path. The root's road-loss and error field remains concrete here, with even loss or vanishing pressure narrowed to leaving visible orientation. Against {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadina}}), it forms the ayah's guidance-versus-straying antithesis and redirects the surrounding accusation into God's knowledge of who truly strayed. Its emphatic onset and doubled liquid give the negative pole a compressed, heavy sound.

topics.headline: straying completed by away-from-path complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb means deviation from a specified path, not error floating without a standard.
topics.reason: The verb instance is intransitive with {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}) and path object, making path-departure the local frame.

topics.headline: established active deviation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text classifies an established deviation by the subject, without naming a causative misleader.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form I active perfect with {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}) as subject, not a passive or causative form.

topics.headline: road-loss and error remain concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that moral error is pictured as losing or leaving a road, while the local complement keeps the image tied to path departure.
topics.reason: The wider root field includes loss and vanishing, but the local {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}) {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}) construction narrows that range to departure from the path.

topics.headline: opposite of guided orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb supplies the negative pole, redirects the surrounding accusation, and is answered by the final guided class.
topics.reason: The supplied rows oppose {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}) to {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadina}}) and connect the local word to formulaic and surah-local adjudication of error.

topics.headline: heavy negative sound shape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negative pole as acoustically compressed and heavy.
topics.reason: The geminated consonant and emphatic onset are surface features that support a modest sound payoff.

words.prose: {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}) is the hinge that turns {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}) from a bare error verb into departure away from a path. Its local sense is separation, not a loose topic marker, because it governs {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}) as the path left behind. The independent preposition keeps the first object-clause open until the standard of deviation is named.

topics.headline: away-from path marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that straying is directional separation from a standard, not merely a topic concerning the path.
topics.reason: The local verb frame selects separation with {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}), and the preposition governs the following path noun.

words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}) closes the first half on the path, not on the act of straying. The suffix makes it His path, resuming {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}), so the standard left behind belongs to the same Lord whose knowledge is asserted. The root's route and accessible-course field makes the contrast spatially intelligible: one may leave the path, and the final guided class answers that departure with orientation. The recited bond from the separation marker into the path noun makes that dependency audible as a single departure phrase.

topics.headline: suffix makes the path His
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is not generic; it is grammatically possessed by the Lord already named.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix is syntactically forced and resolves back to {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}), localizing a divine-possessor path formula.

topics.headline: genitive object of separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is the grammatical standard from which departure occurs and the closure point before the conjunction.
topics.reason: The word is genitive under {{ar:عَن}} ({{tr:'an}}), closing the first clause before {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}).

topics.headline: accessible route and course image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a traversable route image behind the moral classification, while local syntax keeps the selected sense as the Lord's path.
topics.reason: Dictionary range supports path, way, means, and concrete course; the local departure frame selects route/path while allowing course imagery.

topics.headline: path answers into guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path named at the end of the first half becomes the spatial-moral axis answered by the guided class.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence rows link path with straying and guidance, and the local closure places the path before the guided counterpart.

topics.headline: sound binds separation phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the separation marker and path noun as a bound phrase.
topics.reason: The recitational bond supports the syntactic dependency without adding a new lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the final guided group from being swallowed into the first object phrase. After the first clause has closed on {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}), the conjunction starts a second complete predication and balances the negative pole with the positive one. Joined to {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), it also gives the second half a lighter restart that inherits the force of the first clause.

topics.headline: new coequal predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided clause is a coordinated judgment, not an appositive tag on the strayer phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks a second coordinated nominal clause linked to the first.

topics.headline: pivot from negative to positive pole
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction is additive and contrast-balancing at once, making the two categories paired poles.
topics.reason: The local sequence coordinates opposed straying and guided categories under repeated superior knowledge.

topics.headline: fused restart into subject pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second half restart with a lighter but parallel cadence rather than a fresh emphatic particle.

It resumes {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}) without repeating the title, so the same divine subject knows the guided ones as surely as the strayer. Because it follows {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) without a new {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), the second clause feels lighter while still carrying the subject focus already established.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second half preserves the same divine subject without repeating the Lord-title.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies this pronoun as the subject of the coordinated clause and resolves it back to {{ar:رَبَّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbaka}}).

topics.reason: The clause begins {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) and repeats the predicate without repeating {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}).

topics.headline: same pronoun surface changes role

topics.reason: Word 3 is a separating pronoun; word 10 is the subject of the coordinated clause.

words.prose: The second {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}) gives the guided category the same full predicate as the strayer category. It governs the final {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}})-object and remains singular with {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}), so the guided are not the subject of the predicate but its known object. The knowledge root now joins a guidance field, while the local word remains an elative predicate rather than becoming a verb of teaching or guiding. The exact repetition prevents guidance from becoming an afterthought: the same superior knowledge, same object-linking pattern, and opposite object complete the balanced classification.

topics.headline: second predicate governs guided object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided group is the governed object of the same superior-knowledge predicate, not a new subject.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as predicate of {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) and {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadina}}) as the {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}})-governed complement.

topics.headline: guidance equally known
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that right orientation receives the same elative knowledge predicate as deviation, so the positive class is fully adjudicated too.
topics.reason: The same elative form repeats with the same subject; the local grammar keeps both classifications under one authority.

topics.headline: knowledge and guidance field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge root joins a guidance field here, while the local word remains an elative knowledge predicate.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence evidence supports knowledge-guidance association, but local grammar selects superior knowledge rather than teaching or guidance as the word sense.

topics.headline: verbatim predicate balances unequal objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exact repetition balances a relative-clause object against a definite plural object.
topics.reason: The second predicate repeats the first, shares {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}})-government, and completes the opposite pole.

words.prose: The final {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) prepares the ayah's closing noun as the object of {{ar:أَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:a'lamu}}). It repeats the object-link used in {{ar:بِمَن}} ({{tr:bi-man}}), so both halves share the same knowledge-of construction even though the first object is an open relative clause and the second is a definite plural. Its liaison into {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadina}}) makes the closure feel tightly governed rather than loosely appended.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muhtadina}}) closes the ayah on the positive class. Its article and masculine sound plural make the guided a recognized human group, while the active participial form names people characterized by guidance rather than narrating a new guiding event. The Form VIII sense gives guidance participatory orientation: received direction and finding the way, with gift-family pressure adding directed reception without replacing the guidance sense. As the opposite of {{ar:ضَلَّ}} ({{tr:dalla}}), and as the answer to {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}), the final word turns the ayah into a settled classification whose last audible weight is guidance. It also lets the prior tested-identity question resolve into guidance versus deviation, while the open strayer class creates forward pressure toward 68:8.

topics.headline: definite guided human class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing word names a known human class, not an abstract state or open relative clause.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite masculine plural active participle governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}).

topics.headline: participatory guided orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form names people oriented in guidance, with participation, received direction, and directed-reception pressure.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participial plural from Form VIII; gift-family evidence colors directed reception but does not replace the guidance sense.

topics.headline: guided class answers straying and path departure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word is the lexical and structural opposite of straying from the path.
topics.reason: The rows link {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) with {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:d-l-l}}) and {{ar:س ب ل}} ({{tr:s-b-l}}), and the local clauses place them as opposed poles.

topics.headline: final positive endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices and hears that the ayah's final weight lands on guided identity, not on straying.
topics.reason: The final position and long ending give the positive class the closing cadence, while the path vowel thread links it back to {{ar:سَبِيلِهِۦ}} ({{tr:sabilihi}}).

topics.headline: testing question resolves into classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior tested-identity question is resolved as a guidance-versus-deviation classification, with forward pressure toward 68:8.
topics.reason: Boundary rows connect 68:6 to 68:7, tie guidance to Lordship, and point from the open strayer class toward the denier category in 68:8.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled huwa a'lam brackets the one who strayed from His way and the guided, while rabbuka names the knower as owner and governor of that way.
baseline_models.mechanism: Authoritative knowledge discloses and separates two opposed relations to one possessed route: departure from its aim and reception of gentle direction along it. The repeated formula gives both sides equal epistemic coverage without making the trajectories morally equal.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and authority make the way a governed course whose travelers are authoritatively distinguished.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the epistemic act repeated over both trajectories.
Deviation from aim and right course gives the first trajectory its directional failure.
An extended traversable road supplies the shared spatial mechanism rather than a merely abstract polarity.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the opposed trajectory of received orientation.

changed_reading.before: A general assurance that God knows who is right and who is wrong.
changed_reading.after: A formally balanced act of sovereign discrimination in which every movement relative to one governed way is fully disclosed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Rabbuka precedes two temporal shapes: man dalla presents a departure event, whereas al-muhtadin presents an ongoing or settled guided bearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is also the one who tends, repairs, and completes stage by stage. On that branch, the verse can classify processes under care: a person becomes lost from the course, while guided people sustain an aim and manner. Knowledge follows the whole development rather than freezing persons into unexplained labels.

activation_trace.role: Stage-by-stage nurture and repair make the knower also the caretaker of developing trajectories.
A thing lost from its owner turns deviation into a condition that can be tracked rather than an essence.
Direction, aim, manner, and conduct give guidance the shape of a sustained course.
Calm, composed bearing makes the guided participle describe a maintained disposition as well as a correct destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse names two permanent populations, the lost and the guided.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes two differently shaped trajectories known through their development: a departure can occur, and orientation can become a sustained bearing under care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of a'lam stand beside an explicit way, a loss from it, and a guided plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge and visible marking coexist in the focus inventory. A road is followed through distinguishing marks and leading elements, while straying can also disappear from view. The Lord's knowledge therefore encompasses both the traces by which orientation becomes legible and the hiddenness by which deviation evades ordinary observers.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that also guides converts knowledge into the legibility of orientation.
Disappearance and absorption supply the countercondition in which deviation is hidden from ordinary sight.
The traversable route is the field on which marks, disappearance, and direction become consequential.
A guide or leading front supplies a visible orientation that others can follow.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns inaccessible inner states known only to God.
changed_reading.after: The verse also concerns the production, loss, and reading of waymarks: orientation leaves traces, disappearance hides them, and divine knowledge exceeds both conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context surrounds the focus with rival regimes of legibility: a writing reed and ordered lines, their dismissal as false stories, visible signs, and finally a promised bodily mark. This activates the mark branch of knowledge so that 68:7 becomes an adjudication of which inscription actually discloses a trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing and guiding mark makes epistemic discrimination materially legible.
The pared writing reed supplies the first instrument by which a durable line of testimony is made.
Ordered written rows supply inscription as an evidentiary form.
False tales supply the counter-inscription by which genuine signs are rhetorically misclassified.
A manifest sign supplies a visible datum that can be read truthfully or dismissed.
The nose or snout supplies the exposed bodily site on which the promised distinction is externalized.

structural_cues: 68:1, 68:15, and 68:16 move from writing, to dismissal as stories, to a future bodily inscription.
The marking root و س م at 68:16 has no branch inventory and is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, ordered lines, false stories, a manifest sign, a bodily site, and an uncitable marking construction; I infer that outward inscription manifests the discrimination already asserted in 68:7. The live alternative is that the mark is only punitive and not evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is asserted apart from the surah's acts of writing and labeling.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge arbitrates among competing inscriptions: truthful record, dismissive counter-story, and conduct made visibly distinguishable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A public diagnosis covers reason, future mutual sight delays human resolution, and an assay reveals what something is. The focus verse intervenes before that delayed visibility: the Lord already distinguishes the actual trajectory beneath a socially imposed label.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure to the knower supplies the prior judgment that contested observers lack.
The image of reason being covered supplies the opponents' diagnosis and its obscuring mechanism.
Future mutual eyesight makes human recognition a later event rather than the ground of the Lord's knowledge.
Testing metal or a person supplies an assay that separates actual constitution from accusation.

structural_cues: The sequence accusation, future seeing, disputed afflicted party, then doubled divine knowing makes 68:7 the epistemic hinge of 68:2-7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covered reason, deferred sight, and assay; I infer that 68:7 announces the verdict's epistemic basis before public disclosure. The live alternative is that maftun names an afflicted party without invoking an assay process.

changed_reading.before: The verse reassures the addressee by sorting believers from unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The verse overturns a contested diagnosis: public labels can cover reality, whereas the Lord's discrimination precedes and governs eventual seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deviation is assembled socially. Obedience yields to soft mutual accommodation; gossip literally walks between people; transgression crosses a boundary. The Lord's way is therefore not only a proposition but a behavioral route produced by compliance, circulation, and repeated boundary crossing.

activation_trace.role: The extended route gives the social actions a common traversed course.
Departure from aim names the cumulative directional result of those social acts.
Submission and obedience supply the first transfer of agency into another group's course.
Soft accommodation and mutual placation supply the social lubricant by which resistance is reduced.
Gossip carried by walking turns corrupt speech into a route that travels through a community.
Crossing a limit supplies the boundary event by which the walked course becomes transgression.

structural_cues: The prohibitions in 68:8 and 68:10 interrupt a chain from compliance to accommodation, circulating speech, withheld good, and transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obedience, placation, walking gossip, and limit crossing; I infer a causal social route in which each act makes the next easier. The live alternative is a list of traits without a single developmental chain.

changed_reading.before: Straying is an individual's mistaken belief about a religious path.
changed_reading.after: Straying can be a socially walked trajectory whose direction is made by whom one obeys, accommodates, repeats, and follows across limits.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners conceal speech and proceed with a withholding intention, then sight produces the cry that they are lost, followed by the correction that they are deprived. A hidden moral itinerary becomes a spatial misrecognition before becoming self-recognition. The Lord's prior knowing in 68:7 thus includes the intention that makes travelers unable to recognize their own destination.

activation_trace.role: Failure to locate a known thing supplies the literal first layer of the owners' later declaration.
Prior disclosure to the Lord contrasts with the owners' delayed discovery of their own course.
A test that makes condition appear supplies the event by which concealed orientation becomes observable.
Lowered secret speech supplies the hidden planning that ordinary observers cannot hear.
Determined intention supplies the inward vector already directing the morning journey.
Withholding and contraction specify what that determined vector is designed to accomplish.
Eyesight and insight supply the shock at which planned confidence meets an unreadable result.
Loss of a fixed place voices their first spatial explanation for the ruined destination.
Missing the desired good revises the spatial diagnosis into recognition of deprivation.

structural_cues: The sequence 68:23-27 moves from secret intention, to confident travel, to seeing, to 'we are lost,' and then to 'rather, we are deprived.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, secrecy, restrictive intention, sight, lostness, and deprivation; I infer that the prior intention causes an epistemic inability to recognize the destination morally. The literal alternative that they first think they reached the wrong place remains active.

changed_reading.before: The Lord knows who has selected the wrong route.
changed_reading.after: The Lord knows a hidden intention as a trajectory before its travelers can read it; moral deviation may first appear to them as mere spatial confusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A just middle voice interrupts the owners, they clear their Lord of blame, face one another, confess boundary excess, hope for replacement, and redirect desire toward their Lord. This sequence keeps deviation and guidance from becoming sealed identities: recognition can bend a completed straying event into a new orientation.

activation_trace.role: Direction, intention, and conduct make guidance available as a reoriented course after recognition.
Justice and excellence located in the middle supply an internal corrective voice within the deviating group.
Exonerating and declaring transcendence redirect blame away from the Lord and back toward the actors.
Turning face-to-face supplies the first visible pivot from a unified secret plan to mutual accountability.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies their explicit retrospective diagnosis of the route.
Nurture and repair make their doubled return to 'our Lord' a request for developmental restoration.
One thing standing in place of another supplies hoped-for replacement after acknowledged loss.
Desire turning toward or away supplies the clearest directional reversal of their inward aim.

structural_cues: The grammar moves from 'we were wrongdoers' and 'we were transgressors' to present desire directed toward the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an internal corrective, confession, facing, replacement, and redirected desire; I infer a recoverable trajectory that can approach guidance after straying. The live alternative is that remorse is shown without the owners being certified as guided.

changed_reading.before: Those who strayed and the guided are mutually exclusive, permanent identity groups.
changed_reading.after: The Lord can know both moments within one history: completed deviation can be recognized, confessed, and bent toward renewed orientation without erasing what occurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later questions refuse to make the surrendered whole equivalent to the culpable cutter, challenge human judgment, demand its book, and ask for a guarantor behind unsupported claims. The doubled knowledge in 68:7 becomes the warrant for non-equivalence and the standard against which rival verdicts must produce evidence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the Lord supplies the complete epistemic warrant for distinguishing outcomes.
The unrealized human knowing supplies a contrast with the already doubled divine knowing of 68:7.
Making one thing into a state supplies the rejected act of treating unlike trajectories as equivalent.
Wholeness and freedom from defect supply one side of the demanded distinction.
Culpable offense supplies the acquired condition on the other side of the distinction.
Judgment between people supplies the challenged human sorting operation.
A written determination that imposes judgment supplies the demanded documentary warrant.
Speech without certainty supplies the rival claim whose authority is being exposed as empty.

structural_cues: The interrogative run in 68:35-41 repeatedly demands a basis for equating unlike groups and for issuing a competing judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-equation, judgment, a purported book, and unsupported claim; I infer a quasi-forensic challenge in which divine knowledge secures just classification. The live alternative is rhetorical shaming without a formal evidentiary model.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call to bow occurs in two times: once when people are whole and able to respond, and later when they are called but cannot. structural_cues: 68:42-43 repeat the same summons across a changed modal condition: 'they cannot' now, although they were called while whole before.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling, bodily bowing, present inability, and former wholeness; I infer that refused responsiveness hardens into incapacity. The live alternative is that the later inability is imposed punishment rather than habituated formation.

changed_reading.after: The guided can be read as people whose timely response has become a composed capacity, whereas deviation may become embodied inability when the call returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: A counter-route unfolds by walking and being taken degree after degree, specifically from where its travelers do not know, while extended time and a firm strategy keep it stable. The Lord's superior knowledge in 68:7 now includes trajectory beneath perceived position: apparent continuation can be concealed descent.

structural_cues: The explicit contrast is between first-person gradual action and third-person non-knowledge in 68:44, followed by temporal extension in 68:45.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road movement, degree-by-degree taking, non-knowledge, respite, strategy, and firmness; I infer that apparent progress can mask moral descent. The live alternative is simple deferred punishment without any subjective sense of progress.

changed_reading.before: A strayer knows or could readily see that he has left the way.
changed_reading.after: A trajectory can depart by stable, incremental steps while its traveler experiences no epistemic alarm; the Lord knows direction beneath apparent position.

context_deltas.mechanism: Grace catches a person before the counterfactual endpoint of being thrown into exposure while blameworthy; then his Lord selects, draws near, makes, and repairs him into the righteous. This is not merely reclassification after new evidence. Lordly action interrupts one trajectory and produces another.

Selection and drawing near supply a positive reversal from threatened rejection.
Causing a thing to become a state supplies transformation rather than mere relabeling.
Repair opposed to corruption names the newly produced company and condition.

structural_cues: The unrealized apodosis in 68:49 is followed by actual selection and making in 68:50, preserving both the danger and the changed outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interception by grace, a counterfactual rejected state, selection, making, and repair; I infer that the focus categories can describe phases within a divinely redirected history. The live alternative is an exceptional rescue that should not be generalized to every strayer.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge observes which fixed category a person already occupies.
changed_reading.after: The nurturing Lord knows a whole vulnerable history and can catch, select, and remake a person before a threatened endpoint, so classification does not exhaust divine agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: After hearing the reminder, hostile observers nearly use their gaze to dislodge the addressee from his standing. This gives deviation an interpersonal causal grammar: one agent can try to make another lose footing. The Lord's knowledge of who strayed therefore need not flatten pressure, inducement, resistance, and responsibility into one undifferentiated label.

structural_cues: The causative form in 68:51 assigns an attempted maker of slippage, while the addressee remains the threatened object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile looking, hearing the reminder, and attempted loss of footing; I infer that 68:7's perfect 'strayed' can conceal unequal causal pressures unless the knower distinguishes them. changed_reading.after: Straying can be attempted upon someone through hostile pressure; perfect knowledge distinguishes the pressured, the inducer, the resistance, and the eventual trajectory.

structural_cues: The final ayah identifies the discourse itself as a reminder and extends its address to all worlds.

changed_reading.before: Guidance requires entering a route one never possessed.
changed_reading.after: One mode of guidance is recovered memory: the reminder returns a lost orientation that had slipped from retention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins social placation, a smooth road, and hostile slippage into one material model. It remains anchored in the focus road and deviation roots and in two branch-backed context images. Downstream prose should present it as a friction analogy, not as an etymological identity or a claim that all accommodation causes deviation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders guidance as posture and stability rather than chiefly cognition. surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant r-b-w mapping for focus rabb. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus r-b-b secondarily to r-b-w, whose nourishment and growing-up branch can shadow the Lord's relation to the two trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growing up supply the form-distant image of trajectories developing rather than arriving preclassified.

changed_reading.after: A secondary developmental resonance makes the Lord's knowing longitudinal: He knows what trajectories are being nourished, interrupted, and grown toward repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant reading because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for focus h-d-y. It remains anchored by that explicit split mapping and by context branches of stepwise road movement and lost footing. Downstream prose should carry it only as a contrastive phonetic-mapping shadow, never as a lexical gloss of al-muhtadin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's secondary mapping of focus h-d-y includes collapse and a difficult descent, allowing the guided to cast a contrastive shadow of travelers preserved from structural or directional breakdown.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and collapse supply the negative structural shadow against which guidance can appear as preservation.
A difficult descent supplies the form-distant terrain on which orientation is tested.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only positive indication toward a destination.
changed_reading.after: As a tightly contained split-root shadow, guidance also contrasts with incremental descent, loss of footing, and collapse of the support that lets a course continue.

strongest_changes: The garden sequence turns hidden withholding into spatial misrecognition and then moral recognition, showing that the Lord knows a trajectory before its travelers can read it.
The owners' redirected desire and the rescued companion of the fish keep straying and guidance from functioning only as permanent identities.
Stepwise taking from where people do not know makes apparent stability compatible with concealed directional descent.
The repeated call to prostration shifts guidance toward timely embodied responsiveness and exposes a later loss of capacity.
The attempted slippage of 68:51 preserves external pressure and causal agency inside any account of who strays.
The closing reminder activates mnemonic lostness as a repairable mode in which guidance can arrive as recollection.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled a'lam did not collapse into a generic omniscience formula. Its symmetry held together sovereign judgment, stage-by-stage care, waymark legibility, hidden intention, social causation, bodily capacity, and recoverable trajectories without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The garden owners display reorientation, but the packet does not explicitly certify their final guided status.
The later inability to bow may result from accumulated refusal, imposed judgment, or both.
The slippage language may be idiomatic hostile looking rather than a literal causal model of deviation.
The mnemonic, friction, growth, and h-d-d descent readings are branch-backed but deliberately form-distant and require the stated containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Authoritative mapping of opposed courses.** `ر ب ب B001/B002` supplies governing nurture, `ع ل م B001` clear knowledge, `ض ل ل B001` deviation from aim, `س ب ل B001` a traversed route, and `ه د ي B001/B002` guidance and intended direction. The repeated *huwa aʿlam* balances the two populations around one authority. I infer that the nurturer knows trajectories by their relation to the course; the ayah reads dynamically, classifying movement rather than merely assigning static identities.
2. **Lost, hidden, and found.** `ض ل ل B002/B003` permits disappearance and failure to locate, while `ع ل م B002` supplies a distinguishing marker. The garden owners later fail to recognize their place (68:26) before recognizing deprivation (68:27). I infer visible/interpretive markers -> recoverable orientation; the ayah gains a concrete lost-way layer in which divine knowledge reaches what human perception temporarily cannot locate.
3. **Guidance as composed bearing.** `ه د ي B010` adds calm, unhurried composure. Set beside the coercive, whispering, and hurried movements of 68:11-25, I infer that correct direction manifests in manner as well as destination. *Al-muhtadīn* can therefore denote those whose bearing remains composed under pressure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:26's “we are lost” briefly makes *ḍalāl* navigational before 68:31 makes it moral excess, showing how one event can expose both kinds of misdirection. 68:44-45 also confirms that divine knowledge includes trajectories whose steps remain hidden from those traveling them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge that reads behavioral marks.** The doubled fixed `أَعْلَمُ` activates `ع ل م B002` (a distinguishing mark), after the mutual seeing of 68:5 and the assay of 68:6. The packet supplies visible testing and repeated divine knowledge; I infer that conduct leaves signs by which the two courses are distinguished even while people dispute them. God's knowing reads as perfectly diagnostic recognition, not merely possession of information.
2. **Guidance as composed resistance to speech pressure.** Fixed `ٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ` activates `ه د ي B010` (calm stillness and composed bearing). The following prohibitions against obedience in 68:8 and 68:10, the softening proposal in 68:9, and the mobile slander of 68:11 supply a noisy pressure field; I infer that composure blocks that field from redirecting conduct. The guided are read as those whose bearing stays on course under social inducement.
3. **Straying as disappearance from a traversable relation.** Fixed `ضَلَّ` activates `ض ل ل B002` (being hidden or disappearing), while fixed `سَبِيل` activates `س ب ل B001` (an extended traversed way). The packet supplies a way and the subsequent circulation of deceptive speech; I infer that distortion obscures one's relation to the way before it produces overt wrong movement. Straying can thus be loss of visible orientation, not only walking in the wrong direction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:11-12 made the contrast kinetic: speech travels while good is blocked. Against that motion, fixed guidance acquired the unexpected role of composed resistance (`ه د ي B010`), and fixed straying became loss of visible relation to the way (`ض ل ل B002`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A surface becomes socially legible when lines, colors, marks, or attached signs assign content and identity to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The opening pen and closing facial brand belong to one material semiotics: inscription may preserve truth, fabricate reputation, or fasten an identity to a body.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Body Is Read Through Brand, Appendage, and Facial Sign
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A cut or burned mark, a conspicuous appendage, and facial features become indices by which a person or animal is recognized.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: identifying brand or ear-cut (`quranic:root_001650:B001/m01`); reading character from a visible trace (`quranic:root_001650:B002/m01`); hanging ear-tag (`quranic:root_000647:B001/m01`); outsider recognized by an attached tag (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m01`); pedigree mark (`quranic:root_000647:B003/m01`); manifest sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); distinguishing mark or banner (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); split upper lip (`quranic:root_001040:B004/m01`); nose or animal snout (`quranic:root_000404:B001/m01`); head-raised anger and pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The brand on the snout materializes social legibility. `زَنِيم` adds an attached tag that identifies an alien affiliation, while the “sign” and “mark” senses turn bodily appearance into evidence that observers interpret.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Covers Regulate Access to Sight and Interior Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seeing and knowing depend on whether a physical, mental, or social cover protects, obscures, or reveals what lies within.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge of madness is reframed as an argument about covered interiors: eye-films, shields, shelters, ribs, and unspoken thought all test what observers can legitimately infer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Eye, Insight, and the Film That Defeats Both
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An eye opens onto a visible object, inward discernment interprets it, and a woven film or disappearance can interrupt both perception and retention.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ocular sight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); eye-film like a web (`quranic:root_000672:B010/m01`); hidden disappearance (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); loss from memory (`quranic:root_000913:B004/m01`); cognition as disclosure (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:5 `تُبْصِرُ`/`يُبْصِرُ` [ب ص ر]; 68:7 `سَبِيلِ` [س ب ل], `ضَلَّ` [ض ل ل], and `أَعْلَمُ` [ع ل م].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Perception proceeds from open eye to inward verification. The eye-film, disappearance, and failed memory show three distinct ways that evidence can cease to be available, sharpening the contrast between human seeing and divine knowing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Direction Can Guide Bodies or Circulate Harm
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Movement acquires moral and social force through its route, guide, gait, and carried content.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Tale-bearing becomes a corrupted form of wayfaring: the same moving body that can follow a guide can also transport injury between people.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Marked Route, Leading Guide, and Deviation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A route offers access, a guide or leading point establishes direction, and deviation bends a traveler away from the intended line.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: traversable route (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); traveler of the road (`quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`); gentle guidance to route and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); direction and manner of proceeding (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); leading front or guide (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); deviation from aim (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); lost object or location (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); inducement away from truth (`quranic:root_001128:B003/m01`); smooth road (`quranic:root_000497:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:6 `مَفْتُونُ` [ف ت ن]; 68:7 `سَبِيلِ` [س ب ل], `ضَلَّ` [ض ل ل], and `مُهْتَدِينَ` [ه د ي]; 68:9 `تُدْهِنُ`/`يُدْهِنُ` [د ه ن].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Guidance is a spatial operation before it is an abstraction: route, direction, and leading front align movement. Error can be a wrong turn, a lost destination, or an agent’s active deflection of another traveler.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Direction Can Guide Bodies or Circulate Harm

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gait Registers Capacity, Terrain, and Exhaustion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler moves on foot across edges and uneven ground; fatigue, bodily weakness, or reliance on companions alters the gait.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate walking (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); running (`quranic:root_000993:B002/m01`); bank or side of a route (`quranic:root_000993:B009/m01`); hard uneven ground (`quranic:root_000993:B010/m01`); travel on foot (`quranic:root_001525:B012/m01`); supported swaying walk (`quranic:root_001583:B008/m01`); calm, composed gait (`quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`); exhaustion of walker or mount (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`); body worn down by use (`quranic:root_001453:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Movement discloses condition. The same route can carry a runner, an exhausted mount, a composed traveler, or a weakened pedestrian, so gait becomes a visible measure of agency rather than a neutral change of place.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Authority is enacted by keeping charge, binding parties, directing motion, or deciding whether restraint continues.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lordship, contract, bridle-like obedience, coercive hauling, and release from captivity occupy one field of controlled attachment without being reduced to one moral value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mastery as Care, Knowledge, and Watch
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A master owns and tends what is under charge; learned oversight and watchful supervision preserve and direct it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lordship and ownership (`quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`); gradual nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); cultivated authoritative knowledge (`quranic:root_000532:B003/m01`); captain of sailors (`quranic:root_000532:B017/m01`); supervising controller (`quranic:root_000704:B003/m01`); chief whose word carries (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covenant, Surety, and Attached Membership
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An oath or covenant fastens people to one another; a surety carries another’s obligation, and an attached outsider acquires a disputed membership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: alliance and binding pact (`quranic:root_000349:B002/m01`); covenant and protected relation (`quranic:root_000532:B011/m01`); liability that follows its bearer (`quranic:root_000186:B004/m01`); standing surety (`quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`); member attached to a group not originally his (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m02`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: House, Marriage, Children, and Wealth Form One Productive Unit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A dwelling is assembled, marriage initiates a household, children and livestock increase it, and food builds its members’ flesh.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: house built by joined parts (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); marriage and entry into household (`quranic:root_000156:B006/m01`); descent and filiation (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); food building flesh (`quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`); accumulated wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); growth of livestock and offspring (`quranic:root_001427:B003/m01`); bride-gift (`quranic:root_001583:B004/m01`); bride conducted to spouse (`quranic:root_001583:B006/m01`); bridal payment (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m02`); separation from a spouse (`quranic:root_001252:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: “Wealth and sons” expands into a household production scene: architecture, marriage, payment, descent, nourishment, and animal increase. Its reverse is equally concrete in spousal separation and arrested circulation of wealth.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cloud and Falling Water Mark the Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Layered cloud persists, rain descends between sky and earth, and the first seasonal water inscribes the soil with growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: layered rain-cloud (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); downward release of cloud and rain (`quranic:root_000672:B004/m01`); rain suspended between cloud and earth (`quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`); first rain marking earth with plants (`quranic:root_001650:B003/m01`); light wetting rain (`quranic:root_000497:B003/m01`); gentle moist wind (`quranic:root_001525:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rain functions like the pericope’s writing and branding: it descends and leaves a readable mark. Cloud persistence, falling water, moist wind, and newly signed ground form a complete meteorological process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Garden, Grain Ear, and Aromatic Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water drives enclosing vegetation upward; grain extends into ears, low plants spread, and aromatic growth announces itself by scent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); persistent green plant (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); extended grain ear (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); low salt plant (`quranic:root_001252:B007/m01`); halfa grass (`quranic:root_000349:B005/m01`); aromatic plant disclosed by smell (`quranic:root_001557:B004/m01`); summer browse after spring (`quranic:root_000993:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a succession of plant forms rather than a generic “nature” motif. Enclosure, upward density, earing grain, low browse, and scent each mark a different stage or mode by which provision occupies the land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rock Pool, Oil Basin, and Deep Water Store
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Natural and made depressions catch water; their stone edges and depth determine whether the collected resource remains available.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rainwater caught in a rock hollow (`quranic:root_000434:B011/m01`); oil vessel or mountain pool (`quranic:root_000497:B005/m01`); sea or water-rich well (`quranic:root_001040:B005/m01`); abundant collected water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m02`); soft pale basin-stone (`quranic:root_000121:B007/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Provision is stored by topology: hollow, vessel, well, and stone rim. This compact hydrological mechanism usefully pressures the language of favor by showing the material infrastructure through which water becomes durable benefit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A herd is maintained through recent birth, watering, milking, and pasture; shortage appears as low milk, weak issue, or a stray animal outside ownership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recently delivered milk-animal (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); herd of cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m02`); livestock wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); milking camels at the chest (`quranic:root_001453:B004/m01`); low milk and weakness (`quranic:root_000497:B006/m02`); scant reproductive fluid (`quranic:root_001453:B006/m02`); ownerless stray camel (`quranic:root_000913:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herd makes wealth biologically contingent. Birth, milk, pasture, and ownership must remain aligned; weakness, low yield, or straying breaks the sequence by which living assets reproduce provision.

error_profile.loses: Üvey çocuk ile yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üvey çocuk ile annenin veya babanın yeni eşi arasındaki karşılıklı akrabalık rolleri odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle yetimin işlerini üstlenme koşulu komşu dalın sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da biyolojik ebeveyn olmayan bir yetişkinin çocuğun bakımını üstlenmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bakım ilişkisini üvey ailedeki iki yönlü kişi adlarına dönüştürür; komşu dal ise çocuğun yetimliği ve işlerinin görülmesi üzerinden tek yönlü bir görev bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım üstlenme ile üvey aile rolü arasındaki sınırı açıklayan aday seçildi, yalnız çocuk, hane veya genel koruma alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin kendisini ve ondan hareketle yapılan işleme uygulamalarını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaşmış öz ile yağ tortusu seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm veya başka meyvelerden koyulaştırılmış özün söz konusu olduğu yiyecek bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Meyveden elde edilen koyu ve yoğun madde niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri kap, yiyecek veya ilacın koyu öz kullanılarak hazırlandığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Maddeyle işleme ve sağlamlaştırma ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yağın koyu tortusu veya yoğun bir çökeltiyi adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli koyu özü ve onun işleme işlevini anlatır; komşu dal ise ortak bir işlem olmadan çok farklı eriyik ve tortu türlerini aynı ad altında toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir yere bağlanıp oradan ayrılmama çekirdeğini insan, deve ve bulut için destekler; süreklilik ve yaklaşma anlamları da kalıcılık eksenine bağlı yan gelişmelerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel sınır bir yerde kalma ve sürmedir; hareketin kendisi veya bulutun türü bu dalın çekirdeği değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yer, hayvan ve bulutla kurulan bağlı kullanımlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan biri bütün dalın tek yalın anlamı yapılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalıp oradan ayrılmamak veya bir durumun kesilmeden sürmesidir. Hayvanın bir eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma anlamı bu kalıcılık çekirdeğinin özel uzantılarıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, hayvan veya başka bir varlık bulunduğu yere bağlanır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Bulutun ya da rüzgârın sürmesi, kalıcılığın zamansal genişlemesidir.
Hayvanın eşe bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma, çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar yerde kalma, hayvanın belli yere veya eşe bağlanması, bulut ile rüzgârın sürmesi ve yaklaşmayı kalıcılık çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer bağlılığı ile kesintisiz devamın ortak çekirdeğini anlatan genel bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yerden ayrılmama, bağlı kalma ve süreklilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin veya hayvan topluluğunun belirli yerde kalması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yere bağlanma ve oradan ayrılmama sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulutun veya rüzgârın kesilmeden devam ettiği zamansal bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bir durumun kesintisiz sürmesi anlamını korur.

error_profile.adds: Geçici duraklama ve yalnız hareketsizlik gibi kalıcılık gerektirmeyen durumları ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun sürmesi, hayvanın bağlanması ve bir şeye yaklaşma uzantıları odak dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin belirli bir yerde kalıp ayrılmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İnsan için yerleşik kalma alanında güçlü biçimde örtüşürler; odak dal aynı çekirdeği hava olaylarına, hayvan davranışına ve yaklaşmaya genişletir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yerden ayrılmama çekirdeğini en yakın biçimde paylaşan aday seçildi, yalnız süre, hareketsizlik veya hareket alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, birbirine binmiş ya da aşağıda asılı duran bir bulut kümesini ortak kimlik olarak destekler. Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda belirtilse de başka tanıklıklar siyah olabileceğini söylediğinden renk tanımın zorunlu öğesi değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bulutun yapısını ve konumunu anlatır; renk ile yağmur veya bitki yetiştirme sonucu zorunlu tanım öğesi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan bulut kümesi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yağmurun kendisi veya yalnız yağış zamanı bu yalın anlama taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Parçaları birbirine binmiş ya da başka bulutların altında asılı duran bulut kümesidir; beyaz veya siyah olabilir.

facets.statement: Bulut parçaları üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran belirgin bir küme oluşturur.
Beyazlık bazı tanıklıklarda öne çıkar, ancak renk bütün kullanımlar için sabit değildir.
Bitkiyi besleyen yağmurla ilişkilendirilmesi adlandırmanın açıklaması olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı duran bulut yapısında birleşir; renk konusunda beyazlık ile renk değişkenliği arasında fark bulunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bulutun parçalı, üst üste binmiş veya aşağıda asılı yapısını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulut olma, katmanlaşma ve asılı durma özelliklerini korur.

error_profile.adds: Yağmur taşıma zorunluluğu ekler ve katmanlı ya da asılı yapı sınırını belirsizleştirir.
error_profile.collision: Her yağmur bulutunun bu özel yapıda olduğu izlenimini doğurur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirgin ve yoğun bir bulut oluşumunu gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yapısal katmanlaşma ve asılı konumla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise su taşıma, koyu renk ve göksel işaret ilişkisini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, yakın zamanda gerçekleşmişlik, tazelik ve başlangıç evresi çekirdeğini destekler. Yeni doğurmuş ve süt için evde tutulan koyun özel bir uygulama, gençliğin başlangıcı ise insan yaşamına taşınmış bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun, tazelik ve gençliğin başlangıcı aynı düzeyde bağımsız çekirdekler değil; ilk durum genel yenilik sınırının özel gerçekleşmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeni doğurmuş koyun ve gençliğin başlangıcı gibi bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur; bunlar her yalın biçime sınırsızca genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin henüz başlangıcında, yeni ve taze olmasıdır. Yeni doğurmuş koyun ile gençliğin ilk dönemi bu yakın zamanlılık niteliğinin özel uygulamalarıdır.

facets.statement: Temel nitelik yakın zamanda başlamış olma, yenilik ve tazeliktir.
Yeni doğurmuş veya süt için evde tutulan koyun, doğum sonrası yenilik durumunu taşır.
Gençliğin ilk evresi, başlangıç ve tazelik çekirdeğinin insan yaşamına genişlemesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, kura veya kumar oklarını bir arada tutan deri parçası, bez ya da okluk benzeri kabı tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Okların topluca kendisi de kabın bir araya getirme işlevinden doğan yakın kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tek bir ok veya kura çubuğunu değil, bunları bir arada tutan kap ya da topluluğu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız ok ve kura çubuklarını toplayan kap ile toplu oklar anlamında kalır; tek tek ok adlarına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Kura veya kumarda kullanılan ok ve çubukları bir arada tutan deri ya da bez kap; buna bağlı olarak kabın içindeki okların topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Deri veya bezden yapılan kap, kura oklarını ve çubuklarını bir arada tutar.
Kabın içindeki okların topluluğu, kapsayan nesneden kapsanana geçen kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar deri parçası, bez veya okluğa benzer kap anlatımında birleşir ve kura oklarının topluluğunu bununla bağlantılı olarak verir.
